upperSorts.normativeDefinition: A plurality treated as one realization without asserting that it is one object.
A physical or virtual surface delimiting an entity or space.
Information that can be borne by a physical or virtual realization.
A bounded persistent entity that can be individually placed or assembled.
A process-like, event-like, or field-like occurrence.
A physical or logical extent that may contain entities or participate in spatial planning.
Material measured or realized by amount rather than individual identity.
